thread:
sarah (CEO): quick follow-up from today's all-hands – several folks asked for clarity on the reorg rollout and how headcount is being allocated. i'll summarize timeline + priorities here; pls ask clarifying q's below.
jen (Recruiting): thanks sarah! is this a hiring freeze or a reprioritization of open reqs?
dave (CTO): not a freeze. we're reprioritizing approvals for the next two quarters: infra/runtime, Dedicated capacity, and customer-facing product teams get the earliest approvals.
lisa (Dir Eng): concretely: teams focused on latency, autoscaling, model-serving reliability, and KV/prefix caching will be greenlit first.
mike (Product): what's the process for PMs to request priority for a role? form or sync with recruiter/manager?
maria (People Ops): managers should open a prioritization ticket in the hiring queue (internal/hires) and tag @jen + @lisa. we'll triage weekly.
raj (Eng): are IC-level hires being deprioritized in favor of senior hires for speed?
dave (CTO): we want a mix: target ~60% senior+ to move foundational work faster, ~40% mid-level for execution capacity. juniors considered where mentorship exists.
sarah (CEO): timeline: org charts finalized by end of week; role mapping/backfills over next 3 weeks; prioritized reqs start immediately; hiring cadence ramps in Q2.
jen (Recruiting): candidate pipelines keep moving. if a posted role is deprioritized, we'll notify active candidates and pause further interviews.
maria (People Ops): internal mobility: if you want to move to a prioritized team, ping your manager and post in #internal-moves. internal transfers get expedited.
mike (Product): impact on growth/product hires (PLG, UX)?
sarah (CEO): they remain funded but compete for headcount; expect slower hiring pace unless tied to key customer outcomes.
lisa (Dir Eng): org change detail: two infra pods will merge operationally into "Serving" (runtime + serving engine) and "Platform" (infra, autoscale, infra tooling). manager spans mostly unchanged; some TLs may be reassigned. visual org map by Friday.
raj (Eng): any manager role changes planned? new manager hires?
dave (CTO): a small number of manager slots approved, mainly for Dedicated and Private ops. otherwise we prefer IC hires.
jen (Recruiting): hiring managers: pls update job descriptions and leveling rubrics before posting. avoid mismatch in interview loops.
sarah (CEO): comp bands: no company-wide band reset now. exceptions handled by People Ops on a case-by-case basis.
maria (People Ops): relocation/visa: existing offers honored. new reqs needing sponsorship evaluated per region/budget.
raj (Eng): research/applied-ML hiring?
dave (CTO): still hiring ML roles but on a reduced quota; priority for hires that directly improve inference efficiency or model-serving components.
mike (Product): can we see the exact headcount allocation?
maria (People Ops): we'll publish a read-only headcount sheet with buckets (Serving/Runtime, Dedicated/Infra, Product/Growth, Research/ML, Customer Success) by EOD Wednesday.
jen (Recruiting): note: if hire is SLA-critical, mark ticket "urgent-sla" and include customer name to be bumped to top of triage.
lisa (Dir Eng): i'm available for 1:1s with managers who need help mapping teams 
— DM me and i'll set up a sync.
sarah (CEO): we'll keep this thread updated with the org map + headcount doc. if people want a follow-up AM A, we can schedule a short session. :thumbsup: 
raj (Eng): thanks, really helpful.
jen (Recruiting): interview loop updates go out this week; expect small panel changes to reflect new priorities.
oncall-bot: reminder: all-hands follow-up doc uploaded: internal/allhands/2026-03-19-notes.md
